remarks: Welcome to 301 Peach Street! Much of the work has already been done for you, add some finishing touches to make it truly yours! This 3 bedroom, 1 bath home is located just minutes away from Masten Park, the science museum, the 33, and all the conveniences of Main and Genesee Streets. Walk up the front steps to the covered front porch, perfect for relaxing mornings. The living room and bedrooms all have the original hardwood flooring in great condition. The living room also includes a decorative fireplace. The large eat-in kitchen has plenty of cabinet space and newer vinyl flooring. The full bath has charming vintage tile and a deep tub. Upstairs, is the primary suite with a bonus room perfect for play room, home office, of study.
